meta.description: Guide the PM-to-Director transition across preparing, interviewing, landing, and recalibrating. Use when leadership scope is changing and you need practical coaching.

copy.tagline: 指导从产品经理到总监的晋升过渡
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在从PM向总监晋升，需要实战指导。
copy.tagline_en: Guide the transition from PM to Director with practical coaching.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are moving from PM to Director and need hands-on guidance.

howto.what: Claude 会通过提问诊断你处于 PM 转总监的哪个阶段（准备、面试、刚上任或调整期），然后给出针对性的行动建议。
howto.when: 当你提到正在从 PM 晋升总监、刚上任或遇到角色困难时触发。

say.text: 我刚升总监60天，还总忍不住做执行工作，怎么办？
say.note: Claude 会诊断你的情况并给出建议。

say.text: 我准备面试总监岗位，想练习用框架回答面试问题。
say.note: Claude 会引导你模拟面试。

howto.what_en: Claude diagnoses your stage in the PM-to-Director transition (preparing, interviewing, landed, recalibrating) and delivers targeted coaching with actionable recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention transitioning from PM to Director, being newly landed, or facing role challenges.

say_en.text: I'm 60 days into a Director role and still doing PM work. Help.
I'm preparing for Director interviews. Let's practice.
